shortDefinition.en: A standardized setting in the capture-to-output mapping, not a mechanism that adds incoming photons.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 从捕获到输出映射中的标准化设置，不是增加入射光子的机制。

en: Raising ISO at fixed aperture and shutter time does not increase the light that reached the sensor.
zh-cn: 固定光圈和快门时提高 ISO，不会增加已到达传感器的光。

example.en: ISO 800 is one nominal output-mapping stop above ISO 400.
example.zh-cn: ISO 800 比 ISO 400 高一档标称输出映射。

sources.title: What Is ISO in Photography? — Photography Life
sources.supports: The distinction between output brightness mapping and photon collection.
